_note: 解答資料（人工／AI 編輯，不會被自動管線覆蓋）。id 必須存在於 bank.json。answer 只寫 A-D。steps 由網站按序播放動畫；traps 指向易錯選項；tip 是一句話技巧。文字欄位可用 $...$ 寫行內數學（網站會用 KaTeX 渲染）。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 統一度數
第 2 步 · 展開分母

steps.en: Raise every factor inside the bracket to the 4th power — including the $3$.
steps.zh: 括號內每個因式都要 4 次方——包括那個 $3$。

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 相除（指數相減）

steps.en: Subtracting a negative index means adding: $5-(-8)=13$.

traps.en: $3^{14}x^{13}$ — you forgot to raise the $3$ in the denominator to the 4th power (used $3^{1}$ instead of $3^{4}$), giving $15-1=14$.
$3^{2}x^{3}$ — dividing the bases ($27\div3=9=3^{2}$) instead of subtracting the indices.
$3^{4}x^{3}$ — the index of $x$ came out right by accident, but the base $3$ was left as $3^{4}$.
traps.zh: $3^{4}x^{3}$ —— $x$ 的指數碰巧對了，但 $3$ 的指數誤當成 $4$。

tip.en: $a^{m}\div a^{n}=a^{m-n}$; a negative index below the line becomes positive when it moves up.
tip.zh: $a^{m}\div a^{n}=a^{m-n}$；分母的負指數搬到分子就變正。

title.en: Step 1 · Move everything to one side
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 移項整理

steps.en: Bring the right-hand side over so the equation is in standard form.
steps.zh: 把右邊移過來，寫成標準形式。

title.en: Step 2 · Complete the square on both parts
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 兩邊配方

steps.en: Add $4$ to both sides: the left becomes $(x+2)^{2}$, and the right is a perfect square in $k$.
steps.zh: 兩邊加 $4$：左邊成 $(x+2)^{2}$，右邊正好是關於 $k$ 的完全平方。

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 開方（正負都要）

steps.en: Do not drop the negative root — that is where most of the marks are lost.
steps.zh: 千萬不要漏掉負根——這是最常見的失分位。

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 分兩個情況解

traps.en: $x=-k+1$ — the sign of the constant was flipped when expanding $-(k-1)$.
$x=k+3$ — a sign slip on the $-2$ after taking the positive root.
traps.zh: $x=k+3$ —— 取正根後 $-2$ 的符號出錯。

traps.en: $x=k+3$ or $x=-k+1$ — both sign errors at once.
traps.zh: $x=k+3$ 或 $x=-k+1$ —— 兩個符號錯誤同時出現。

tip.en: $x^{2}+bx=(\text{something})^{2}$ is solved fastest by completing the square — and always keep $\pm$.
tip.zh: 見到 $x^{2}+bx=(\text{某式})^{2}$，配方最快——而且一定要保留 $\pm$。

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 相加求解

traps.en: $6$ — you forgot the two $k$'s add up to $2k$ and solved $k+32=38$.
traps.zh: $6$ —— 忘記兩個 $k$ 相加是 $2k$，直接當成 $k+32=38$。

traps.en: $-3$ — $32$ was subtracted from the wrong side ($32-38=-6$).
$-6$ — a sign error on the constant term on top of the $2k$ slip.
traps.zh: $-6$ —— 常數項符號與 $2k$ 兩處同時出錯。

tip.en: For $f(a)+f(-a)$ with an even power and a linear term, the linear parts partly cancel — substitute carefully first, simplify second.
tip.zh: 遇到 $f(a)+f(-a)$（含偶次方與一次項），一次項通常會部分抵消——先老實代入，再化簡。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 讀出柱狀圖數據

steps.en: Books read (value) : number of teachers (frequency). Total $=4+8+6+2+2=22$ teachers.
steps.zh: 閱讀本數（值）：教師人數（頻數）。合共 $4+8+6+2+2=22$ 位教師。

title.en: Step 2 · Locate the quartiles by position
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用位置定位四分位數

steps.en: Cumulative counts: the 3's occupy positions 1–4, the 4's 5–12, the 5's 13–18, the 6's 19–20 and the 7's 21–22.
Both surrounding positions fall in the same block, so no interpolation is needed.
steps.zh: 前後兩個位置都落在同一組，所以無需插值。

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 四分位距

traps.en: $4$ — that is the RANGE ($7-3=4$), not the inter-quartile range.
$3$ — using $n/4=5.5$ and $3n/4=16.5$ as positions (which bracket 4 and 7) instead of the $(n+1)/4$ convention.
$2$ — subtracting the number of categories instead of the quartile values.
traps.zh: $2$ —— 用組別數相減而非四分位數值相減。

tip.en: For a frequency table, build the cumulative counts first — quartiles are positions, never the $x$-values themselves.
tip.zh: 頻數表一定要先做累積計數——四分位數是「位置」，不是 $x$ 值本身。
